title: Guide a listener between sections
objective: Connect the question, method, result and final message in a short talk.

slides.title: Use a signpost at each change
body: A signpost tells listeners where you are going.
“To answer this question, we …” introduces a method. “Here is what we found” leads to a result.

slides.title: Connect two sections
body: Method: We watched a flower bed for ten minutes. Result: Four bees visited.
Model: “We watched the flowers for ten minutes. During that time, we saw four bees.”
Close: “Next time, we will watch at another time of day.”

slides.title: Read the first case together
body: Talk notes: We watched frogs. We visited two ponds. One pond had a higher count. We want to visit again.

slides.title: Try it with a partner
body: Introduce your topic and preview the talk.
Write one line to move from your method to the finding.
Try: First I will explain ___. Then I will show ___.

slides.title: Try a new case
body: Talk notes: We watched birds. We visited two gardens. One garden had a higher count. We want to visit again.

slides.title: Work on your own
body: Introduce your topic and preview the talk.
Write one line to move from your method to the finding.
Close with a summary and a next step.

slides.title: Test the order
body: Ask your partner to give the order of your talk. Add one transition where they lost the order.
